recap.text: Last time, I jumped out a window with a fire hose. And my landlord grabbed the other end.

climb.text: Bad news. He's coming down after me.

slide.text: I slide. He slides faster. Of course he does.

valve.text: Then somebody turned on the water.

gym.text: A gym. The power is on... but nobody is here.

mira.text: Hello? Is anyone up there? This is Mira. I'm in the lobby.

end.text: Part four. Follow, and help me decide who to trust.
